#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Serialized native gate for the local three-party continuation.
# Usage: gate.sh core|mathlib MODULE [MODULE...]
#   core    -> python3 scripts/check.py --core-profile ...            (paper16 / Init-Lean-Std closures)
#   mathlib -> python3 scripts/check.py --memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048 ...
# scripts/check.py, its caps, locks and pins are unchanged. This wrapper only
# waits politely when the single compiler lock is busy (exit 75) or the memory
# gate is closed (exit 76), and raises a flag so the background cache warmer yields.
set -u
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"; root="$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)"
profile="${1:?profile}"; shift
case "$profile" in
  core) flags=(--core-profile) ;;
  mathlib) flags=(--memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048) ;;
  *) echo "profile must be core or mathlib" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
flag="$here/logs/gate-waiting.$$"; : > "$flag"; trap 'rm -f "$flag"' EXIT
cd "$root" || exit 2
deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + ${GATE_WAIT_SECONDS:-1500} ))
while :; do
  touch "$flag"
  python3 scripts/check.py "${flags[@]}" "$@"; rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 75 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 76 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "GATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT rc=$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"; fi
  sleep $(( rc == 76 ? 20 : 3 ))
done

## G05 — calibration of the type guards

### Plan

Task: (1) does `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entail the refit guard at `ty`; (2) `ArrowCodomainInversion`
for the actual calibrated type program at a `Settings` with closed type list; (3) the #1453 statements
with no premise beyond that closure.

What was read: this ledger's G04 section, `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`, the two `…GuardFree…` modules,
`NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.lean` (48 lines), `NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepPrograms.lean`
lines 20–65, the three general-`tv` application targets of #1438/#1440/#1442, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. **The window does not test the guard at an operand's own type.** `Q.window =
   thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V` = `conjunction (conjunction P.W (V∘proj 2)) (conjunction
   thinContextPresent (thinOwnSeed …))`, and `P.W` bottoms out in `strictAuxWindow base (refitGuard s T)
   = intrinsicQuery (strictAuxIntrinsic base (refitGuard s T))`. `intrinsicQuery F` is the equality test
   `F(ctx, k) = succ ty`. The guard program occurs in exactly one place, `admittedChildren` inside
   `strictAuxPositive` (`NumberedWindowInternalStrictAuxWindowTargets.lean:26`,
   `…AuxWindowStepTargets.lean:31`): at a key of auxiliary shape it is applied to the key's fields 0 and
   1 (`dom`, `cod`). At every other key the row is the base callback's value. So for an open `k` the
   formula `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` contains no occurrence of the guard at `ty`; an entailment would
   need an internal case analysis on the shape of `k` plus a separate "types of windowed terms are
   guarded" lemma per shape. Grep found the forward rule only (`ExactOpenAuxWindow`: guards ⟹ window)
   and `ExactOpenCoverNumberedTypeWindow` (numbered key ⟹ grammar membership of the stored annotation,
   not of `T`, and not of the window's own `ty` in general). Numerically the same picture:
   `NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.termParts` checks `w.1.contains` on the own type for tags 0, 1, 3,
   on the arrow and the domain for tag 2, on field 1 for tag 5, on fields 1 and 0 for tag 6, and on
   **no type at all** for tag 4.
   Item 1 as posed is therefore answered NO; nothing is gated for it.
2. **The actual type programs carry numeric calibration only.** `exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves`
   (`…AuxWindowStepPrograms.lean:52`) obtains `T` from `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` applied to
   `Primrec (typeGuard s ·)`; `ConcreteAddressPositive` and `GuardedAt` give `tv`/`T` under `∃` with
   `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv [n] = (typeBit n).toNat` and `TypeGuardCalibrated s T : ∀ ty,
   run T ty = (typeGuard s ty).toNat`, `typeGuard s ty = typeBit ty && s.window.1.contains ty`. These are
   existentially chosen programs with an evaluation equation and no known AST; the repository's stated
   rule (`InternalAcceptanceTargets.lean:26`) is "Natural evaluation is calibration only, never reflected
   into Derivation". No object-calculus derivation for open `dom`, `cod` follows. Item 2 as posed is
   answered: only the numeric calibration exists.
3. **Closure is not a field of `Settings`.** `structure Settings` is `window : List Nat × List Nat`,
   `types : List Nat`, `equivalentHeads`. The repository's closure predicate is `ChildClosed W`
   (`…FreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets.lean:19`: `arrow σ τ ∈ W → τ ∈ W`, codomain only) on a separate
   `W : List ProbeTy`, tied to `s` by `TypeSupport s W` inside `ValidWindow s W`, whose docstring says
   "Numerical interface only … not used as a rule of the object theory". `GrammarTypeInclusion s` is
   `s.window.1 ⊆ s.types`, not a closure. No `SubtypeClosed`-style predicate on `s.types` exists.
4. **The #1453 premise is false in the standard model for the actual calibrations.** In #1453 the
   same `TV` fills the scalar slot, whose calibration is `ActualTypeGuard` (the syntax slot asks
   `TypeSyntaxCalibrated`, whose definition I did not open). With `TV`
   calibrated to `typeBit` (all valid type codes, infinitely many) and `refitGuard s T` to `typeGuard s`
   plus membership in `s.types` (finite), `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T` reads "every valid type code is
   in the finite window list", and `TypeGuardArrowCalibration` fails the same way at any valid `dom`
   outside the window. This is an argument (it also needs soundness of the calculus), not a gated
   theorem. Consequence: the route "`TV` ⟹ refit guard" cannot be the calibration of the actual tuple.

What the accepted material does support (and what is attempted here): the scalar's own type-checker
slot `tv` of `install` is a free parameter in the general statements of #1438/#1440/#1442. Installing
`tv := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)` makes scalar acceptance of the two operands supply BOTH type
programs at `rawCons dom cod` and at `dom` (`exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` + `conjunctionRecover`).
What remains is then exactly codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T` — the shrink item 1
asked for, reached through the scalar slot instead of the window. `SyntaxGuardRefits` disappears. The
refit inversion further splits (via `exact_OpenSettingsRefitGuardReports`) into inversion of `T` and
inversion of literal membership in `s.types`.

### Targets + sha256 (recorded before the proof module was drafted)

`LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationTypeCalibrationTargets.lean`
sha256 `12593c684f85288ae3302bd34268a9b07e68c918a6a4828e1eee004031ecf932`

Definitions: `refittedScalarType s TV T := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)`, `GrammarCodomainInversion
body s` (internal rule: membership of `rawCons dom cod` in the literal list `s.types` ⟹ membership of
`cod`). `ArrowCodomainInversion` is reused from the G04 targets.
Statements: `ExactRefitGuardCodomainInversionFromComponents`,
`ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`, `ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationOutputAddress`,
`ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
`ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.

### Receipts

- `1795402855547066197-3279443` (`build-reports/1795402855547066197-3279443.json`, sha256
  `fbaf544591d75df7ae9da7fc365df83410b3ccd5e55aa1e11c8d01b077b348c5`) — `gate.sh mathlib` on
  `…TypeCalibrationTargets` and `…TypeCalibrationProof`: COMPILE_PASS for both. Five `#print axioms`
  lines, each `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- Proof module sha256 `d0073128acd68b38e5efb88c177a478edabc895a1c0c6ae39de85f45bbe5cecc`; targets
  sha256 unchanged from the frozen value above.

### Failures

No failed gate (one run, passed first time). Two shell commands were refused by the permission mode
(a command substitution, and a heredoc append to this ledger); the same content was written with the
file tools instead — no effect on the work.

Task items not achieved, stated as failures of the brief rather than of the compiler:
- Item 1 (window ⟹ refit guard at its type): answered NO by reading the definitions; not gated.
- Item 2 (`ArrowCodomainInversion` for the actual type program): not provable from accepted material;
  only numeric calibration exists and `Settings` carries no closure.
- Item 3: not reached.

### State and next

STOPPED AT FIRST GATED STATEMENT. Gated: for the installation with scalar type checker
`conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)`, the three application statements with no type-guard hypothesis,
under `ArrowCodomainInversion body TV` and `ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T)`; plus the
split of the latter into `T` and literal `s.types` membership. Evidence in
`TYPE-CALIBRATION-EVIDENCE.json`, claims and non-claims in `TYPE-CALIBRATION-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

This result is about a different installed tuple than #1453 and its two premises are open internal
statements. It should not be reported as "type guards discharged".

Next, in order:
1. Decide whether the refitted scalar is acceptable at all: check what downstream of
   `ActualTypeGuard tv` (`AddressPositiveComposition`, `ConcreteAddressPositive`, `GuardedAt`) breaks
   when `tv` computes `typeGuard s` instead of `typeBit`. If `TypeSupport`-style facts make the two
   agree on accepted addresses, the numeric chain can be re-stated; if not, this route is dead and the
   refit guard at `dom` must instead come from an internal "windowed terms have guarded types" lemma
   by shape of `k`.
2. `GrammarCodomainInversion body s` from numeric closure of `s.types` under arrow codomains: look for
   an elimination rule for `memberGraph` at a numeral list (only `ExactAllInputScratchMembership` and
   `ExactOpenScratchMinimumOccurs` were seen in `…SparseScratchMembershipTargets`). This is the one
   premise that is plausibly a finite internal case analysis.
3. `ArrowCodomainInversion` for `TV` and `T` needs named programs, not existential witnesses: replace
   `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` witnesses by an explicit `typeBit` program with an internal unfolding
   rule at `suc (pairTerm a b)`. That is new construction work, not a calibration lookup.
For the scalar installed with the type checker conjunction TV (refitGuard s T) instead of TV: two accepted operand addresses at one context give the application's output address, frontend acceptance and output functionality with no type-guard hypothesis, under two premises that remain open as rules of the object calculus: codomain inversion of TV and of refitGuard s T (the second split into inversion of T and literal membership in the settings' type list). Caveats from the authoring lane: the refitted scalar is narrower than the accepted actual type guard and it was not checked that the accepted numeric installation chain survives that choice; this is not 'type guards discharged'. Reading-level findings, not gated: the installed window does not test the refit guard at its own type; the accepted calibrations of the type programs are numeric only; and #1453's premise SyntaxGuardRefits is false in the standard model for the actual calibrated programs.

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveFoldTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm (contextView typeBit)
open NumberedWindowCopyAlgorithm (Entries)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets
  (ActualRawCalibration ActualLeastCalibration ActualAdvanceCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveFoldTargets
  (ActualFuelCalibration ActualPositiveCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositive (addressPositive)

def ActualContextGuard (p : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, evaluate p (n ::ᵥ nil) = (contextView n).isSome.toNat

def ActualTypeGuard (p : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, evaluate p (n ::ᵥ nil) = (typeBit n).toNat

def ActualAddressPositiveCalibration (entries : Entries) (s : Settings)
    (ctxValid tyValid : Program 1) (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3) : Prop :=
  ∀ source cert target,
    evaluate (addressPositive ctxValid tyValid raw least)
      (source ::ᵥ cert ::ᵥ target ::ᵥ nil) =
        (NumberedWindowConcreteCheckers.positive entries s source cert target).toNat

/-- Calibration is the original complete checker even at malformed raw
addresses, contexts, types, and witness codes; not an admitted-input
agreement. The actual selected same-fiber core remains unmodified. -/
def AddressPositiveComposition : Prop :=
  ∀ (entries : Entries) (s : Settings) (ctxValid tyValid : Program 1)
    (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3),
    ActualContextGuard ctxValid → ActualTypeGuard tyValid →
    ActualPositiveCalibration entries s raw least →
    ActualAddressPositiveCalibration entries s ctxValid tyValid raw least

/-- Genuine executable choices exist together for both validation
programs and the same actual raw/least/advance/fuel/positive chain.
No caller-supplied numeral checker or semantic oracle is presumed. -/
def ConcreteAddressPositive : Prop :=
  ∀ (entries : Entries) (s : Settings),
    ∃ (ctxValid tyValid : Program 1) (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3),
      ActualContextGuard ctxValid ∧ ActualTypeGuard tyValid ∧
      ActualRawCalibration entries s raw ∧ ActualLeastCalibration s least ∧
      ActualAdvanceCalibration entries s raw least ∧
      ActualFuelCalibration entries s raw least ∧ ActualPositiveCalibration entries s raw least ∧
      ActualAddressPositiveCalibration entries s ctxValid tyValid raw least

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (someAddressPositive)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets
  (ActualContextGuard ActualTypeGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets
  (ActualRawCalibration ActualLeastCalibration ActualAdvanceCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveFoldTargets
  (ActualFuelCalibration ActualPositiveCalibration)

/-- These are the actual numeric callees of the installed AST, not
interface assumptions asserted as object-language implications. -/
def CallbacksAt (xs : Entries) (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1)
    (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3) : Prop :=
  ActualContextGuard cv ∧ ActualTypeGuard tv ∧
  ActualRawCalibration xs s raw ∧ ActualLeastCalibration s least ∧
  ActualAdvanceCalibration xs s raw least ∧ ActualFuelCalibration xs s raw least ∧
  ActualPositiveCalibration xs s raw least

/-- The same `accepts` expression used by original matching, with
certificate in its middle slot, inside the actual newly installed
source body. The raw four-field report belongs to that physical r. -/
def InstalledReportAt (i j cv tv : Program 1) (d : Program 3)
    (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3) : Prop :=
  let r := addressPositive cv tv raw least
  ∀ (c : Nat) (α : Type) (left cert right : OTerm α),
    let accepted := accepts r left cert right
    let reported := someAddressPositive cv tv raw least left cert right
    Nonempty (Derivation (sourceBody (data i j r d) c) []
      ((accepted.imp reported) ⊓ (reported.imp accepted)))

/-- Literal existing TupleAt interface; its original i/j/d, guarded p,
v, chosen A/H, typing, and given-fresh alignment are reinstantiated
on this body. All coordinate programs remain individually available. -/
def InstalledTupleAt (xs : Entries) (s : Settings) (W : List ProbeTy)
    (i j cv tv : Program 1) (d p₀ : Program 3)
    (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3) (v : Inputs) : Prop :=
  TupleAt xs s W i j (addressPositive cv tv raw least) d v ∧
  v.applicationGuard = guard i p₀ ∧
  CallbacksAt xs s cv tv raw least ∧
  InstalledReportAt i j cv tv d raw least

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseTuple

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (conjunction)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitter (addressGood rawContext rawResult rawLeast)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope (applyUnary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary suc z)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalCoordinatesTargets (canonicalCoordinates)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRawTargets (ActualPackedWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets (ActualLeastCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendTargets (ActualScalarCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets (ActualContextGuard ActualTypeGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (addressReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositive (addressPositive)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveOutputTargets (equivalent)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast (packedLeastProgram)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRaw (typedRaw5)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoveredWindowTargets (coveredWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseSymmetricExchangeTargets (pairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)

def shapeChecks (cv tv : Program 1) : Program 1 :=
  conjunction addressGood (conjunction (applyUnary cv rawContext) (applyUnary tv rawResult))

def coordinateCall (W least : Program 3) : Program 1 :=
  .composition (canonicalCoordinates W least) ![rawContext,rawResult,rawLeast]

def addressScalar (cv tv : Program 1) (W least : Program 3) : Program 1 :=
  conjunction (shapeChecks cv tv) (coordinateCall W least)

def ExactAddressScalarCalibration : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (W least : Program 3), ActualContextGuard cv → ActualTypeGuard tv →
    ActualPackedWindow s W → ActualLeastCalibration s least → ActualScalarCalibration s (addressScalar cv tv W least)

/-- On the supplied literal tag-three fields, unit acceptance is exactly the
two original validity calls and coordinate canonicality, in the same calculus. -/
def ExactReportedAddressScalar : Prop :=
  ∀ (cv tv : Program 1) (W least : Program 3) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (q ctx ty k : OTerm α), let checks := unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓
      (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ windowAt (canonicalCoordinates W least) ctx ty k)
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((addressReport q ctx ty k).imp
      (equivalent (unary (addressScalar cv tv W least) (suc z) q) checks)))

/-- The original full three-address-slot positive program itself supplies
both full unary carriers without supplying any fields or validity hypotheses. -/
def ExactPositiveAddressCarriers : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (baseW root other : Program 3) (syntaxProg cv tv : Program 1)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (a cert b : OTerm α),
    let W := coveredWindow C s baseW
    let X := guardedExchange C s (pairedExchange baseX)
    let least := packedLeastProgram C X W s
    let raw := typedRaw5 root other W syntaxProg
    let i := addressScalar cv tv W least
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((programGraph (addressPositive cv tv raw least) (suc z) ![a,cert,b]).imp
      (unary i (suc z) a ⊓ unary i (suc z) b)))
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressTargets

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSlotsProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSideProof
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm (contextView typeBit)
open NumberedWindowCopyAlgorithm (Entries)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope (run)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitter (addressGood rawContext rawResult rawLeast)
open NumberedWindowInternalAtomicRefinementNumericFieldsProof (literalFields)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveFoldTargets (ActualPositiveCalibration packedPositive)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositive
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericShapeProof
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSlotsProof

theorem fields {q : Nat} (d : Decoded q) :
    run rawContext q = d.ctx ∧ run rawResult q = d.ty ∧ run rawLeast q = d.classCode := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c⟩ := literalFields d.ctx d.ty d.classCode
  exact ⟨(congrArg (run rawContext) d.nameEq).trans a,
    (congrArg (run rawResult) d.nameEq).trans b,
    (congrArg (run rawLeast) d.nameEq).trans c⟩

theorem reportsOf {cv tv : Program 1} (hc : ActualContextGuard cv) (ht : ActualTypeGuard tv)
    {q : Nat} (d : Decoded q) : sideReports cv tv q := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_⟩ := fields d
  refine ⟨(shape q).mpr ⟨d.ctx,d.ty,d.classCode,d.nameEq⟩,?_⟩
  rw [a,b]
  change evaluate cv (d.ctx ::ᵥ nil) = 1 ∧ evaluate tv (d.ty ::ᵥ nil) = 1
  simp [hc d.ctx,ht d.ty,d.contextOk,d.typeOk]

theorem decodedOf {cv tv : Program 1} (hc : ActualContextGuard cv) (ht : ActualTypeGuard tv)
    {q : Nat} (side : sideReports cv tv q) : Nonempty (Decoded q) := by
  obtain ⟨c,t,k,h⟩ := (shape q).mp side.1
  have f1 : run rawContext q = c := by rw [h]; exact (literalFields c t k).1
  have f2 : run rawResult q = t := by rw [h]; exact (literalFields c t k).2.1
  obtain ⟨ctx,type⟩ := side.2
  rw [f1] at ctx
  rw [f2] at type
  change evaluate cv (c ::ᵥ nil) = 1 at ctx
  change evaluate tv (t ::ᵥ nil) = 1 at type
  rw [hc c] at ctx
  rw [ht t] at type
  have ty : typeBit t = true := by
    cases e : typeBit t <;> simp_all
  cases e : contextView c with
  | none => simp [e] at ctx
  | some stack => exact ⟨⟨c,t,k,stack,h,e,ty⟩⟩

theorem coreOf {entries : Entries} {s : Settings} {raw : Program 5} {least : Program 3}
    (cal : ActualPositiveCalibration entries s raw least)
    {x y : Nat} (w : Nat) (l : Decoded x) (r : Decoded y) :
    evaluate (callFold raw least) (tape x w y) = 1 ↔
      NumberedWindowPositivePathAlgorithm.positive (NumberedWindowConcreteCheckers.step entries s)
        (NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm.least s) l.stack l.ty l.classCode w r.classCode = true := by
  obtain ⟨lc,lt,ls⟩ := fields l
  have rd := (fields r).2.2
  rw [foldCall,lc,lt,ls,rd,cal l.ctx l.ty l.classCode w r.classCode]
  unfold packedPositive
  rw [unpackContext l.contextOk]
  simp only [Option.any_some]
  split <;> simp_all

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSideProof

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSideProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericCompositionProof
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion
open InternalApplicationStepPeelEvaluationSupportProof (conjunctionEvaluation)
open NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm (addressView)
open NumberedWindowPositivePathAlgorithm (addressRS)
open NumberedWindowCopyAlgorithm (Entries)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitter (rawContext rawResult)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveFoldTargets (ActualPositiveCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositive
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericShapeProof
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSlotsProof
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveNumericSideProof

private abbrev step (entries : Entries) (s : Settings) := NumberedWindowConcreteCheckers.step entries s
private abbrev leastOf (s : Settings) := NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm.least s

private theorem fromOriginal {entries : Entries} {s : Settings} {cv tv : Program 1} {raw : Program 5} {least : Program 3}
    (hc : ActualContextGuard cv) (ht : ActualTypeGuard tv) (cal : ActualPositiveCalibration entries s raw least)
    (x w y : Nat) (h : addressRS (step entries s) (leastOf s) x w y = true) :
    sideReports cv tv x ∧ (sideReports cv tv y ∧
      (NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope.run rawContext x =
        NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope.run rawContext y ∧
      (NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope.run rawResult x =
        NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope.run rawResult y ∧
       evaluate (callFold raw least) (tape x w y) = 1))) := by
  cases hx : addressView x with
  | none => simp [addressRS,hx] at h
  | some lx =>
    rcases lx with ⟨Γ,t,b⟩
    cases hy : addressView y with
    | none => simp [addressRS,hx,hy] at h
    | some ry =>
      rcases ry with ⟨Δ,u,c⟩
      have tests : ((Γ == Δ) = true ∧ (t == u) = true) ∧
          NumberedWindowPositivePathAlgorithm.positive (step entries s) (leastOf s) Γ t b w c = true := by
        simpa only [addressRS,hx,hy,Bool.and_eq_true,and_assoc] using h
      have stackEq : Γ = Δ := by simpa using tests.1.1
      have typeEq : t = u := by simpa using tests.1.2
      obtain ⟨l,ls,lt,lk⟩ := viewDecoded hx
      obtain ⟨r,rs,rt,rk⟩ := viewDecoded hy
      have ce := (sameContext l.contextOk r.contextOk).mpr (ls.trans (stackEq.trans rs.symm))

  least : Program 3

/-- A successful actual scalar call at the reported original address supplies
the physical window and the same measured packed least fixed point. In
particular, a function-window premise need not be inferred from an arbitrary
successful least call. -/
def ExactInstalledCarrierCoordinates : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (q ctx ty k : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport q ctx ty k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) q)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓
      (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
        leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s ctx ty k k))))

/-- Conversely, the original report and the same physical checks reconstruct
unit acceptance by the installed scalar. This closes the wrapper equivalence,
not just a one-way weakening of its admission predicate. -/

  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (q ctx ty k : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport q ctx ty k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓
      (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
        leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s ctx ty k k)))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) q))

/-- Both directions of the unchanged original application report, now at the
one installed scalar and measured least. No carrier or output-success premise
is added to the original report. -/
def ExactInstalledApplicationReport : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (f u y : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    let accepted := programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![f,u,y]
    let reported := applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least f u y
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((accepted.imp reported) ⊓ (reported.imp accepted)))

/-- The actual installed member-edge program preserves the selected source
measure. No preservation assumption is imposed on the unrestricted directed
exchange; the installed program includes its literal comparison guard. -/
def ExactInstalledMeasurePreserving : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    MeasurePreservingEdge Q.edge (selectedMeasure Q.source.R)

one installed scalar and measured least. No carrier or output-success premise
is added to the original report. -/

  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (f u y : OTerm α),

    let reported := applicationReport Q.scalar Q.least f u y
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((accepted.imp reported) ⊓ (reported.imp accepted)))

measure. No preservation assumption is imposed on the unrestricted directed
exchange; the installed program includes its literal comparison guard. -/

  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv tv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv tv root other
    MeasurePreservingEdge Q.edge (selectedMeasure Q.source.R)

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericTargets

import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceCalibrationProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTestEvaluationProof
import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.NumberedMultisetNumericSupportProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericProof
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceCalibrationProof (actualConjunctionEvaluation)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTestEvaluationProof (vectorTwo)
open NumberedMultisetNumeric (numbersNumber)
open NumberedMultisetNumericSupportProof (numbersRoundTrip)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowMemoTargets (typeGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeDispatchProgramControlProof (literalEvaluation)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope (run)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipNumericChecks (exact_AllInputScratchMembership)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericTargets

private theorem listCode (xs : List Nat) : Encodable.encode xs = numbersNumber xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [Encodable.encode_list_cons,Encodable.encode_nat,ih,numbersNumber,Nat.add_comm 1] <;> rfl

private theorem memberOne (s : Settings) (ty : Nat)
    (member : ty ∈ s.types) :
    evaluate (grammarTypeAt s) (ty ::ᵥ nil) = 1 := by
  let T := s.types
  let xs := ty ::ᵥ nil
  let calls : Fin 2 → Program 1 :=
    ![NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeDispatchProgram.literal 1 (Encodable.encode T),.projection 0]
  change evaluate NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership.scratchMember
    (List.Vector.ofFn (fun i => evaluate (calls i) xs)) = 1
  rw [vectorTwo]
  change evaluate NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership.scratchMember
    (evaluate (NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeDispatchProgram.literal 1 (Encodable.encode T)) xs ::ᵥ
      ty ::ᵥ nil) = 1
  rw [literalEvaluation, exact_AllInputScratchMembership, listCode, numbersRoundTrip]
  have hit : (T.any (fun head => head == ty)) = true :=
    List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨ty,member,by simp⟩
  change (T.any (fun head => head == ty)).toNat = 1
  rw [hit] <;> rfl

theorem exact_SettingsRefitGuardCalibration : ExactSettingsRefitGuardCalibration := by
  intro s T included original ty
  change evaluate (refitGuard s T) (ty ::ᵥ nil) = (typeGuard s ty).toNat
  have originalValue : evaluate T (ty ::ᵥ nil) = (typeGuard s ty).toNat := original ty
  rw [refitGuard,actualConjunctionEvaluation,originalValue]
  cases h : typeGuard s ty
  · simp [h]
  · have listed : s.window.1.contains ty = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).2
    have present : ty ∈ s.types := included ty (List.contains_iff_mem.mp listed)
    simp [h,memberOne s ty present]

#print axioms exact_SettingsRefitGuardCalibration

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericProof

  simp only [shapeChecks,acceptedBoth,sideReports]
  change _ ∧ (run (applyUnary cv rawContext) q = 1 ∧ run (applyUnary tv rawResult) q = 1) ↔ _

private theorem call (W least : Program 3) (q : Nat) :
    run (coordinateCall W least) q = evaluate (canonicalCoordinates W least)
      (run rawContext q ::ᵥ run rawResult q ::ᵥ run rawLeast q ::ᵥ nil) := by
  change evaluate (canonicalCoordinates W least) (List.Vector.ofFn (fun i : Fin 3 =>
    run ((![rawContext,rawResult,rawLeast] : Fin 3 → Program 1) i) q)) = _
  rw [vectorThree]

  intro s cv tv W least hc ht hw hl q
  rw [addressScalar,actualConjunctionEvaluation]

      simp [scalar,view,he]

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm
open NumberedWindowExchangeAtoms (HeadPairs)
open NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm (Window)
open NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm (Address addressView)

/-- Closed over the finite original signature and window by the source calibration. -/
structure Settings where
  window : Window
  types : List Nat
  equivalentHeads : HeadPairs

def admitted (s : Settings) (ctx : List Nat) (ty n : Nat) :=
  NumberedWindowLexicalAlgorithm.typed ctx ty n && (NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.bits s.window n).1

def edge (s : Settings) (ctx : List Nat) (ty a b : Nat) :=
  (NumberedWindowExchangeAlgorithm.bits s.equivalentHeads a b).1 &&
    admitted s ctx ty a && admitted s ctx ty b

def vertices (s : Settings) (n : Nat) :=
  (NumberedWindowCoverBoundsAlgorithm.cover s.window.2 s.types n).getD []

def least (s : Settings) (ctx : List Nat) (ty n : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  NumberedWindowClassAlgorithm.least (edge s ctx ty) (vertices s n) n

def canonical (s : Settings) (a : Address) : Bool :=
  admitted s a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2 && (least s a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2 == some a.2.2)

def scalar (s : Settings) (n : Nat) := (addressView n).any (canonical s)

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationTypeCalibrationTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstallDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseTupleDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationRefittedInstallTargets
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm (typeBit addressView)
open NumberedWindowCopyAlgorithm (Entries)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings canonical)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets (ProbeTy)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedTyped (Inputs)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepTargets (TypeGuardCalibrated)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardNumericTargets (GrammarTypeInclusion)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets (ActualContextGuard ActualTypeGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRawTargets (ActualPackedWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets (ActualLeastCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontendTargets (ActualScalarCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressTargets (addressScalar)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTuple (InstalledTupleAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationTypeCalibrationTargets (refittedScalarType)

/-- Every valid type code lies in the window's finite type list. This is the
numeric content of `ActualTypeGuard` for the refitted type checker. It asks a
finite list to contain every code accepted by `typeBit`; no claim is made here
about whether any `Settings` satisfies it. -/
def AllTypesWindowed (s : Settings) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : Nat, typeBit n = true → s.window.1.contains n = true

/-- Every address the original scalar algorithm accepts has its own type in
the window's finite type list. Purely numeric: `addressView` and `canonical`
are the original algorithm's functions, decidable at each address. It is a
condition on `s`, not a consequence of the calibrations; no finite reduction
of the quantifier over addresses is claimed. -/
def AcceptedTypesWindowed (s : Settings) : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : Nat) (ctx : List Nat) (ty k : Nat), addressView q = some (ctx, ty, k) →
    canonical s (ctx, ty, k) = true → s.window.1.contains ty = true

/-- The refitted scalar type checker computes the window type guard
`typeGuard s`, on every natural input, when its two components carry their
accepted calibrations and the window types are grammar types. -/
def ExactRefittedScalarTypeCalibrated : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1), GrammarTypeInclusion s →
    ActualTypeGuard TV → TypeGuardCalibrated s T →
    TypeGuardCalibrated s (refittedScalarType s TV T)

/-- If the refitted type checker satisfied the accepted `ActualTypeGuard`
calibration, every valid type code would be in the window list. Only the
calibration of `T` is used. -/
def ExactRefittedTypeGuardActualOnlyIf : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1), TypeGuardCalibrated s T →
    ActualTypeGuard (refittedScalarType s TV T) → AllTypesWindowed s

/-- Under the accepted calibrations the refitted type checker satisfies
`ActualTypeGuard` exactly when every valid type code is in the window list. -/
def ExactRefittedTypeGuardActualIff : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1), GrammarTypeInclusion s →
    ActualTypeGuard TV → TypeGuardCalibrated s T →
    (ActualTypeGuard (refittedScalarType s TV T) ↔ AllTypesWindowed s)

/-- The accepted installed-tuple predicate, instantiated at the refitted type
checker, forces every valid type code into the window list: its callback
conjunct contains `ActualTypeGuard` of that checker literally. -/
def ExactRefittedInstalledTupleOnlyIf : Prop :=
  ∀ (xs : Entries) (s : Settings) (W : List ProbeTy) (i j cv TV T : Program 1)
    (d p₀ : Program 3) (raw : Program 5) (least : Program 3) (v : Inputs),
    TypeGuardCalibrated s T →
    InstalledTupleAt xs s W i j cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) d p₀ raw least v →
    AllTypesWindowed s

/-- The address scalar built with the refitted type checker computes the
original scalar algorithm on every natural input exactly when every accepted
address has a windowed own type. The calibrations of the context guard, of
`TV`, of `T`, of the window and of the least program are the accepted ones. -/
def ExactRefittedAddressScalarCalibrationIff : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Settings) (cv TV T : Program 1) (W least : Program 3),
    GrammarTypeInclusion s → ActualContextGuard cv → ActualTypeGuard TV →
    TypeGuardCalibrated s T → ActualPackedWindow s W → ActualLeastCalibration s least →

private theorem boolOne (b : Bool) : b.toNat = 1 ↔ b = true := by
  cases b <;> decide

private theorem bitValue {x : Nat} {b : Bool} (bit : x = 0 ∨ x = 1) (iff : x = 1 ↔ b = true) :
    x = b.toNat := by
  cases b with
  | false =>
    rcases bit with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (iff.mp h) (by decide)
  | true => exact iff.mpr rfl

private theorem conjBit {n : Nat} (p q : Program n) (v : List.Vector Nat n) :
    evaluate (conjunction p q) v = 0 ∨ evaluate (conjunction p q) v = 1 := by
  rw [conjunctionEvaluation]
  split <;> simp

private theorem guardSplit (s : Settings) (n : Nat) :
    typeGuard s n = true ↔ typeBit n = true ∧ s.window.1.contains n = true := by
  show (typeBit n && s.window.1.contains n) = true ↔ _
  exact Bool.and_eq_true_iff

private theorem refittedValue {s : Settings} {TV T : Program 1} (inc : GrammarTypeInclusion s)
    (hTV : ActualTypeGuard TV) (hT : TypeGuardCalibrated s T) (n : Nat) :
    evaluate (refittedScalarType s TV T) (n ::ᵥ nil) = (typeGuard s n).toNat := by
  have refit : evaluate (refitGuard s T) (n ::ᵥ nil) = (typeGuard s n).toNat :=
    exact_SettingsRefitGuardCalibration s T inc hT n
  have iff : evaluate (conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)) (n ::ᵥ nil) = 1 ↔
      typeGuard s n = true := by
    constructor
    · intro one
      have r := ((acceptedBoth TV (refitGuard s T) (n ::ᵥ nil)).mp one).2
      rw [refit] at r
      exact (boolOne _).mp r
    · intro g
      have tb : typeBit n = true := ((guardSplit s n).mp g).1
      refine (acceptedBoth TV (refitGuard s T) (n ::ᵥ nil)).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hTV n]
        exact (boolOne _).mpr tb
      · rw [refit]
        exact (boolOne _).mpr g
  exact bitValue (conjBit TV (refitGuard s T) (n ::ᵥ nil)) iff

private theorem guardEqBit {s : Settings} (all : AllTypesWindowed s) (n : Nat) :
    typeGuard s n = typeBit n := by
  by_cases tb : typeBit n = true
  · rw [tb]
    exact (guardSplit s n).mpr ⟨tb, all n tb⟩
  · by_cases g : typeGuard s n = true
    · exact absurd ((guardSplit s n).mp g).1 tb
    · exact (eq_false_of_ne_true g).trans (eq_false_of_ne_true tb).symm

  intro s TV T inc hTV hT n

  intro s TV T hT actual n tb

    (actual n).trans (congrArg Bool.toNat tb)
  have r : evaluate (conjunction T (grammarTypeAt s)) (n ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
    ((acceptedBoth TV (refitGuard s T) (n ::ᵥ nil)).mp one).2
  have t : evaluate T (n ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
    ((acceptedBoth T (grammarTypeAt s) (n ::ᵥ nil)).mp r).1
  have c : evaluate T (n ::ᵥ nil) = (typeGuard s n).toNat := hT n
  rw [c] at t
  exact ((guardSplit s n).mp ((boolOne _).mp t)).2

  constructor
  · exact exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualOnlyIf s TV T hT
  · intro all n

  obtain ⟨_, actual, _⟩ := callbacks
  exact exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualOnlyIf s TV T hT actual

    run (shapeChecks cv tv) q = 1 ↔ sideReports cv tv q := by
  change evaluate (shapeChecks cv tv) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 ↔ _
  simp only [shapeChecks,acceptedBoth,sideReports]
  change _ ∧ (run (applyUnary cv rawContext) q = 1 ∧ run (applyUnary tv rawResult) q = 1) ↔ _
  rw [applyValue,applyValue]
  rfl

    evaluate (addressScalar cv tv W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 ↔
      sideReports cv tv q ∧ run (coordinateCall W least) q = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have both := (acceptedBoth (shapeChecks cv tv) (coordinateCall W least) (q ::ᵥ nil)).mp h
    exact ⟨(shapeOne cv tv q).mp both.1, both.2⟩
  · intro h
    exact (acceptedBoth (shapeChecks cv tv) (coordinateCall W least) (q ::ᵥ nil)).mpr

    scalar s q = canonical s (ctx, ty, k) := by
  show (addressView q).any (canonical s) = canonical s (ctx, ty, k)
  exact congrArg (Option.any (canonical s)) view

private theorem scalarIff {s : Settings} {cv TV T : Program 1} {W least : Program 3}
    (inc : GrammarTypeInclusion s) (hc : ActualContextGuard cv) (hTV : ActualTypeGuard TV)
    (hT : TypeGuardCalibrated s T) (hw : ActualPackedWindow s W)
    (hl : ActualLeastCalibration s least) :
    ActualScalarCalibration s (addressScalar cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least) ↔
      AcceptedTypesWindowed s := by
  have orig : ∀ q, evaluate (addressScalar cv TV W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = (scalar s q).toNat :=
    NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressNumericProof.calibration s cv TV W least
      hc hTV hw hl
  have refit : ∀ m, run (refittedScalarType s TV T) m = 1 ↔ typeGuard s m = true := by
    intro m
    have v : run (refittedScalarType s TV T) m = (typeGuard s m).toNat :=
      refittedValue inc hTV hT m
    rw [v]
    exact boolOne _
  have plain : ∀ m, run TV m = 1 ↔ typeBit m = true := by
    intro m
    have v : run TV m = (typeBit m).toNat := hTV m
    rw [v]
    exact boolOne _
  constructor
  · intro cal q ctx ty k view can
    obtain ⟨d, _, dty, _⟩ := viewDecoded view
    have accepted : scalar s q = true := (scalarAt view).trans can
    have one : evaluate (addressScalar cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
      (cal q).trans (congrArg Bool.toNat accepted)
    obtain ⟨side, _⟩ := (scalarOne cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least q).mp one
    obtain ⟨_, _, ty1⟩ := side
    rw [(fields d).2.1, dty] at ty1
    exact ((guardSplit s ty).mp ((refit ty).mp ty1)).2
  · intro windowed q
    have bit : evaluate (addressScalar cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 0 ∨
        evaluate (addressScalar cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
      conjBit (shapeChecks cv (refittedScalarType s TV T)) (coordinateCall W least) (q ::ᵥ nil)
    refine bitValue bit ?_
    constructor
    · intro one
      obtain ⟨side, co⟩ := (scalarOne cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least q).mp one
      obtain ⟨good, ctxOk, tyOk⟩ := side
      have tb : typeBit (run rawResult q) = true :=
        ((guardSplit s _).mp ((refit _).mp tyOk)).1
      have plainOne : evaluate (addressScalar cv TV W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
        (scalarOne cv TV W least q).mpr ⟨⟨good, ctxOk, (plain _).mpr tb⟩, co⟩
      have v := orig q
      rw [plainOne] at v
      exact (boolOne _).mp v.symm
    · intro accepted
      have plainOne : evaluate (addressScalar cv TV W least) (q ::ᵥ nil) = 1 :=
        (orig q).trans (congrArg Bool.toNat accepted)
      obtain ⟨side, co⟩ := (scalarOne cv TV W least q).mp plainOne
      obtain ⟨d⟩ := decodedOf hc hTV side
      have view := decodedView d
      have can : canonical s (d.stack, d.ty, d.classCode) = true :=
        (scalarAt view).symm.trans accepted
      have listed : s.window.1.contains d.ty = true :=
        windowed q d.stack d.ty d.classCode view can
      have g : typeGuard s d.ty = true := (guardSplit s d.ty).mpr ⟨d.typeOk, listed⟩
      obtain ⟨good, ctxOk, _⟩ := side
      have tyOk : run (refittedScalarType s TV T) (run rawResult q) = 1 := by
        rw [(fields d).2.1]
        exact (refit d.ty).mpr g
      exact (scalarOne cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) W least q).mpr ⟨⟨good, ctxOk, tyOk⟩, co⟩

theorem exact_RefittedAddressScalarCalibrationIff :
    ExactRefittedAddressScalarCalibrationIff := by
  intro s cv TV T W least inc hc hTV hT hw hl
  exact scalarIff inc hc hTV hT hw hl

theorem exact_RefittedInstalledScalarCalibrationIff :
    ExactRefittedInstalledScalarCalibrationIff := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other Q inc hc hTV hT hw hl
  exact scalarIff inc hc hTV hT hw hl

#print axioms exact_RefittedScalarTypeCalibrated
#print axioms exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualOnlyIf
#print axioms exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualIff
#print axioms exact_RefittedInstalledTupleOnlyIf
#print axioms exact_RefittedAddressScalarCalibrationIff
#print axioms exact_RefittedInstalledScalarCalibrationIff
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationRefittedInstallProof

private theorem boolOne (b : Bool) : b.toNat = 1 ↔ b = true := by

private theorem bitValue {x : Nat} {b : Bool} (bit : x = 0 ∨ x = 1) (iff : x = 1 ↔ b = true) :
    x = b.toNat := by
  cases b with
  | false =>
    rcases bit with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (iff.mp h) (by decide)
  | true => exact iff.mpr rfl

private theorem conjBit {n : Nat} (p q : Program n) (v : List.Vector Nat n) :

  rw [conjunctionEvaluation]

private theorem guardSplit (s : Settings) (n : Nat) :

private theorem refittedValue {s : Settings} {TV T : Program 1} (inc : GrammarTypeInclusion s)

    · intro g

    exact ⟨(shapeOne cv tv q).mp both.1, both.2⟩
  · intro h

# Refitted installation guards — source map (Fable-2, round 4, G06)

Modules: `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationRefittedInstall{Targets,Proof}.lean`.
Receipt `1795404207507881578-3290394`. Every theorem: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

Subject: the scalar type checker of #1461, `refittedScalarType s TV T = conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)`,
against the accepted installation's numeric calibration `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv [n] =
(typeBit n).toNat`.

## Claimed (gated)

All statements are about natural-number evaluation of programs. None is a rule of the object calculus.

| Theorem | Statement |
|---|---|
| `exact_RefittedScalarTypeCalibrated` | `GrammarTypeInclusion s`, `ActualTypeGuard TV`, `TypeGuardCalibrated s T` ⟹ the refitted checker computes `typeGuard s` (= `typeBit n && s.window.1.contains n`) on every input. |
| `exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualOnlyIf` | `TypeGuardCalibrated s T` and `ActualTypeGuard (refitted)` ⟹ `AllTypesWindowed s`. |
| `exact_RefittedTypeGuardActualIff` | Under the three calibrations above: `ActualTypeGuard (refitted) ⟺ AllTypesWindowed s`. |
| `exact_RefittedInstalledTupleOnlyIf` | `TypeGuardCalibrated s T` and `InstalledTupleAt xs s W i j cv (refitted) d p₀ raw least v` ⟹ `AllTypesWindowed s`, for all other arguments. |
| `exact_RefittedAddressScalarCalibrationIff` | Under `GrammarTypeInclusion s`, `ActualContextGuard cv`, `ActualTypeGuard TV`, `TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualPackedWindow s W`, `ActualLeastCalibration s least`: `ActualScalarCalibration s (addressScalar cv (refitted) W least) ⟺ AcceptedTypesWindowed s`. |
| `exact_RefittedInstalledScalarCalibrationIff` | The same equivalence for `Q.scalar`, `Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refitted) root other`, with `ActualPackedWindow s Q.window` and `ActualLeastCalibration s Q.least` as hypotheses. |

Named conditions (both `def … : Prop` in the targets module):

- `AllTypesWindowed s := ∀ n, typeBit n = true → s.window.1.contains n = true`.
- `AcceptedTypesWindowed s := ∀ q ctx ty k, addressView q = some (ctx, ty, k) → canonical s (ctx, ty, k) =
  true → s.window.1.contains ty = true`.

Suppliers: `NumberedWindowInternalSparseCanonicalAddressNumericProof.calibration`
(`ExactAddressScalarCalibration`), `exact_SettingsRefitGuardCalibration`, `acceptedBoth`,
`conjunctionEvaluation`, `decodedOf`, `decodedView`, `viewDecoded`, `fields`, `applyValue`. The six-line
private lemma `shapeOne` restates the private `shape` of `…SparseCanonicalAddressNumericProof.lean`
with the same proof text.

## Assumed (hypotheses, not discharged here)

- `GrammarTypeInclusion s` (window types are grammar types). The accepted statements that use
  `refitGuard` carry the same premise.
- `ActualTypeGuard TV`, `TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualContextGuard cv`: the accepted calibrations of
  the component programs.
- `ActualPackedWindow s W`, `ActualLeastCalibration s least`. For the measured route these are stated
  on `Q.window` and `Q.least`; it was **not checked** whether an accepted theorem supplies them for
  `thinMatchingWindow` and the measured `packedLeastProgram`. `GuardedAt` supplies the corresponding
  facts for its own factored route, which is a different window and exchange.
- `AcceptedTypesWindowed s` itself, wherever the equivalence is used left to right. It is a condition
  on the settings; it is not derived from anything.

## Not claimed

- That `AllTypesWindowed s` is false. It is false for every `s` by this argument, which is **not
  gated**: `typeBit 0 = true` and `typeBit` is closed under pairing of valid codes
  (`NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm.nextType`; equivalently `exact_ExactTypeGuard : typeBit n =
  (decodeTy n).isSome`), so valid codes are unbounded, while `s.window.1` is a finite list. Granting
  it, `exact_RefittedInstalledTupleOnlyIf` reads: `InstalledTupleAt` never holds at the refitted
  checker, hence no witness of `GuardedAt` or `ConcreteAddressPositive` has it as `tv`.
- That `AcceptedTypesWindowed s` holds for the settings of the paper, or that it reduces to a finite
  check over the window. The round-3 reading that `termParts` tests no type for tag-4 keys suggests it
  can fail; that reading is not gated either.
- Any statement about `ActualAddressPositiveCalibration` at the refitted checker (the `positive`
  program `addressPositive cv tv raw least`), about `TupleAt`'s `Evaluates`/`Interprets` components, or
  about `EdgeCarriersAt`. `AddressPositiveComposition` uses `ActualTypeGuard tv` in both directions in
  the same way as the scalar calibration, so the same kind of condition is expected; not proved.
- Anything about the two open codomain-inversion premises of #1461.
- Any derivation in the object calculus. The derivation-level installation facts (#1430's four
  statements; the general application statements of #1438/#1440/#1442) are quantified over every `tv`
  with no calibration hypothesis; they apply to the refitted checker by instantiation, which is what
  #1461 already does. Nothing new is gated about them here.

## Reading of #1461

- Its statements are true as stated and unaffected: they are derivation-level statements about
  `install … (refittedScalarType s TV T) …` and use no numeric calibration of the type checker.
- The scalar in them is **not** the scalar of an accepted `InstalledTupleAt` / `GuardedAt` tuple: that
  predicate requires `ActualTypeGuard tv`, which the refitted checker has only if every valid type
  code is windowed. So #1461 cannot be composed with any statement that takes `InstalledTupleAt`,
  `CallbacksAt` or `GuardedAt`'s tuple as given.
- Whether its scalar is at least extensionally the original scalar algorithm is now exact:
  it is, on every input, if and only if `AcceptedTypesWindowed s` (given the listed calibrations).
  Without that condition the refitted route accepts strictly fewer addresses than `scalar s`.

# Fable-2 ledger — local round 4 (2026-11-22)

## G06 — refitted installation guards

### Plan

Task: settle the caveat of #1461 (round 3, G05): does the accepted installation survive when the
scalar's type checker is `refittedScalarType s TV T = conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)` instead of a
program calibrated to `typeBit`?

What was read: round-3 ledger section G05 and `1461-SCOPE.txt`; the two `…TypeCalibration…` modules;
`NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveCalibrationTargets.lean`,
`…SparseTupleDefinitions.lean`, `…SparseCanonicalAddressTargets.lean`,
`…SparseAddressPositiveNumericSideProof.lean`, `…SparseAddressPositiveNumericCompositionProof.lean`,
`…SparseCanonicalAddressNumericProof.lean`, `…SettingsGrammarGuardNumericProof.lean`,
`…CoverCombinedMeasuredInstall{Definitions,Targets}.lean`, `NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm.lean`,
`NumberedWindowAddressAlgorithm.lean`, `GuardedAt` in `…GuardedMatchingInstallationTargets.lean`
(lines 91–116), the #1430 entry of `verification/github-continuation-2026-11-22/root/ACCEPTANCE.json`;
greps for definitions and lemma names.

Where `ActualTypeGuard tv` occurs (complete grep over `LogicLineages/`: 12 hits in 5 files):

| Site | Role of `ActualTypeGuard tv` | What it is used for |
|---|---|---|
| `AddressPositiveComposition` (`…AddressPositiveCalibrationTargets.lean:33`) | hypothesis | `reportsOf` (type field of a decoded address passes `tv`) and `decodedOf` (a passing `tv` gives `typeBit`); both directions, so `addressPositive cv tv raw least` computes the original `positive` on every input |
| `ConcreteAddressPositive` (same file, `:43`) | conjunct under `∃ tv` | the chosen `tv` is produced with this calibration |
| `ExactAddressScalarCalibration` (`…CanonicalAddressTargets.lean:43`) | hypothesis | same two lemmas; `addressScalar cv tv W least` computes the original `scalar s` on every input |
| `CallbacksAt` (`…SparseTupleDefinitions.lean:33`) | conjunct | part of `InstalledTupleAt` (three instances inside `GuardedAt`, each with the existential `tv`) |
| `…NumericSideProof.lean`, `…NumericCompositionProof.lean` | hypothesis of the lemmas above | — |

Where it does not occur: the four statements of #1430
(`ExactInstalledCarrierCoordinates`, `ExactInstalledCarrierFromCoordinates`,
`ExactInstalledApplicationReport`, `ExactInstalledMeasurePreserving`) quantify over every `cv tv` with
no calibration hypothesis, and so do the general application statements of #1438/#1440/#1442 that
#1461 instantiates. `TypeGuardCalibrated s T` concerns the window's guard `T` (a different slot);
in `GuardedAt` it is a conjunct on the existential `T`, independent of `tv`.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. The derivation-level facts #1461 relies on (`exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` and the three
   general application theorems) hold for every `tv`, the refitted one included. Nothing to repair.
2. The numeric chain does not accept the refitted `tv` as stated. Under the accepted calibrations
   (`ActualTypeGuard TV`, `TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `GrammarTypeInclusion s`) the refitted checker
   computes `typeGuard s n = typeBit n && s.window.1.contains n`, so `ActualTypeGuard` of it says
   "every valid type code is in the finite window list". `CallbacksAt`, hence `InstalledTupleAt`, at
   the refitted `tv` carries that conjunct literally. So no `GuardedAt` witness has the refitted `tv`.
3. The conclusion the scalar's calibration lemma delivers (`ActualScalarCalibration s (addressScalar
   cv tv W least)`) does not need `ActualTypeGuard tv` itself: it needs only that the narrower checker
   never rejects the own type of an address the original scalar accepts. That is a numeric condition
   on `s`, and it is also necessary.

Targets: (i) refitted checker is `TypeGuardCalibrated s`; (ii) `ActualTypeGuard` of it ⟹ / ⟺
`AllTypesWindowed s`; (iii) `InstalledTupleAt` at it ⟹ `AllTypesWindowed s`; (iv) scalar calibration of
`addressScalar cv (refitted) W least` ⟺ `AcceptedTypesWindowed s`, and the same for
`(install … (refitted) …).scalar` given calibration of that route's window and least programs.

Not attempted: falsity of `AllTypesWindowed s` for every `s` as a gated theorem (it needs unboundedness
of valid type codes; `exact_ExactTypeGuard : typeBit n = (decodeTy n).isSome` exists but the
encode/decode round trip was not read). The analogous equivalence for
`ActualAddressPositiveCalibration` (the `positive` checker) and for `TupleAt`'s `Evaluates` component.
The two codomain-inversion premises of #1461 (excluded by the brief).

true → s.window.1.contains ty = true`.
